locked_decisions: The semantic loop is Roadmap -> Watch -> Knowledge check -> Quiz/Test -> Reflect -> Implement -> Human review -> Improve/Retry.
Canonical activity, progress, evidence, draft, reviewer, and completion state remains server-owned.
Video, captions, transcript, resume, speed, fullscreen, and PiP are conditional on approved sources, policy, and browser capability.
Knowledge checks and quiz/test feedback is authored and deterministic; no autonomous AI scoring or mastery claim is present.
Human review appears only from an explicit assigned-reviewer contract and is append-safe.
Offline preserves only approved local recovery/read cache and never performs a canonical write or hidden background submit.
Direction B Momentum Workshop is the selected visual language; Direction A and C remain bounded references.
tokens_or_visual_direction: deep navy ink and cobalt action
light warm-white task surface on pale blue-gray canvas
thin cool-gray dividers and restrained 9-12px radii
desktop task column plus roadmap rail
mobile one-column task with safe-area-aware bottom navigation
semantic native controls and Lucide-sized icons; no raster-as-UI
known_gaps: Approved media, provenance, caption tracks, transcript, playback-session, and resume contracts are not activated.
Browser support for speed, fullscreen, and PiP requires real desktop/iOS/Android evidence.
Assessment interaction schema and any official result semantics require controlled promotion.
Human reviewer assignment, privacy, visibility, and append-only correction contract require evidence.
Offline cache allowlist, local recovery retention, and service-worker update proof require release checks.
No Drive, Notion, Figma, Canva, or Lucid artifact was created by this package.
do_not_infer: media provider, CDN, signed URL, codec, duration, captions, transcript, upload type, or playback guarantee
watched completion from page open, seek, elapsed hidden time, or analytics
score, mastery, rank, reward, pass/fail, competency certification, or autonomous AI evaluator
reviewer identity, coach, external call, recording, transcription, or real-world action verification
offline canonical writes, background synchronization of learning mutations, or native iOS/Android app
payment, billing, entitlement, notifications, social, marketplace, or broad LMS navigation
implementation_rule: Use the matrix and behavioral spec as authority; use images only as reference; leave tests and implementation evidence before any runtime promotion.
